text: With the core goals of "ensuring food supply security, enhancing food nutritional quality, and promoting food industry innovation", the research focuses on the chemical composition, physical and chemical properties, and biological activities of food, as well as the change patterns of food during processing, storage, and transportation. At the same time, new food processing technologies are developed, production processes are optimized, and quality control systems are established. The core task is to balance "food supply" and "health needs", and to address technical bottlenecks (such as preservation, reduction of loss, and functionalization) and safety risks (such as contamination and spoilage) in the food industry.
